data.gender_notes: AlGhani is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ghana', meaning to gain or acquire. AlGhani is a name that signifies abundance, generosity, and wealth in both spiritual and material aspects. This name is often given to children as a reminder to be righteous, charitable, and thankful for the blessings bestowed upon them. The name AlGhani carries the meaning “Generous, Wealthy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlGhani usually hope their child will grow to embody generous, wealthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name is also associated with the idea of "Al- Ghani Fil-Lilah," which means "rich in Allah's good pleasure," a term used to describe those who have attained spiritual and moral wealth through the pursuit of knowledge, good deeds, and strong faith.

It encourages individuals to be generous, kind, and charitable, reminding us of the importance of sharing our blessings with others. The Hadiths of the Prophet Muhammad emphasize that the true wealth lies in attaining Allah's pleasure, and that the act of giving is a means of drawing closer to Him. By choosing this name, parents are encouraging their children to cultivate a strong spiritual foundation, one built on generosity, kindness, and thankfulness. The name AlGhani can serve as a daily reminder to strive for both material and spiritual wealth, working towards a balanced and fulfilling life in accordance with Islamic teachings.
